That is wrong and it is why this item has carried for weeks without moving. ifm-make-previews.sh only selects rows whose video/drive field is an ifm-deploy.vercel.app URL resolving to a file already inside the repo; every one of these 61 rows points at Google Drive, so the script finds nothing. Verified by running it: 'Nothing to build — no unplayable video has a local master.' THE MISSING STEP is fetching the master from Drive (rclone copy by file id) before the existing ffmpeg step. Write that and the rest of the path already works. Once clips exist, two deploys are still needed: media-audit.py decides playability by HEAD-requesting the live URL, so deploy one ships the clips and deploy two ships the regenerated media-map.js.

items.source: ingest-scan.py --scan does not save its result
items.title: The snapshot the scanner is supposed to leave behind, content/v1-prototype/.ingest-scan.json, is still dated 21 Sep 2026 — three weeks stale — because only --validate writes it; --scan prints its counts and throws the result away. Every run since has had to re-walk Drive and keep the result in a scratch file, and there is no on-disk record to diff one day against the next. Two passes 22 minutes apart today returned 1,833 and 1,850 media files across 163 and 164 folders, both with 0 errors, and they cannot be reconciled because the first was not kept — it is either the known Drive listing instability or 17 files genuinely arriving mid-scan, and there is no way to tell. Three lines in scan() would fix it.

items.source: Monthly WhatsApp trailer — a recurring job with no owner in the system
items.title: Raised by Aditya 12 Oct 2026: "month on month we make videos for IFM trailer to share on WhatsApp". It is a RECURRING need and nothing in the repo treats it as one — there is no skill, no scheduled task and no checklist, so each month it is rebuilt from memory. WHAT ALREADY EXISTS: the approved cut IFM-workshop-whatsapp.mp4 (54s vertical 1080x1920, ~12MB, built 20 Aug 2026, signed off), its build directory highlight-reel-assets/whatsapp-build/ (render.js, audioV.py, node_modules present), and a written method in the project-whatsapp-workshop-video memory: live clip audio ducked under music (1.0 -> 0.18, 0.35s ramps), speech windows picked by scoring 0.25s frames on 300-3400Hz energy, 9:16 crops centred on an OpenCV face centroid, ends holding 6s on the flyer. RAW MATERIAL IS READY: 136 adult assets dated Sep 2026 or later (102 video, 22 photo), the biggest blocks being Corporate women's workshop session 2 on 6 Oct (22), the Swayamvar game session on 8 Sep (20), the small-group Sep session (9) and Corporate women's workshop 1 Oct (9). NOT STARTED — Aditya was asked whether to cut October now or build the monthly skill and chose neither for the moment, so this is parked rather than in progress. TWO RULES THAT MUST SURVIVE INTO ANY MONTHLY VERSION: the workshop is for adult women, so no teen/Gen-Z footage may be used to promote it; and the speech-window scorer finds CLEAR speech, not appropriate speech, so a human has to listen before anything is sent.
